## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

S5.6 landed the whole Stage-5 adapter layer on
top of S4.9's Stage-4 fleet core (`WorkItem`,
the reconciler, `control.work_item.*`):

| AC/leg | Landed | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Generic signed-webhook ingress (AC-9) | `hmac-sha256:<hex>` over the canonical payload, `key_ref` resolved broker-side (key bytes never ledgered), delivery-id + content occurrence keys (OQ-313), replay-window dedupe → `skipped{duplicate_occurrence}`, closed schema decode | `crates/hh-fleet/src/ingress.rs` |
| Capability declarations + probing (AC-9, T-LCD-07) | Quad-state `unknown`/`declared`/`probed`/`probed_absent`; probing resolves `unknown` only and never downgrades `declared`; `push_delivery_id` probed from delivery evidence; unknown names/invalid states fail closed | `crates/hh-fleet/src/capabilities.rs` |
| Real tracker adapter as an L5 plugin (AC-9) | `hh-fleet-adapter` — the `work_source_adapter` class wire codec + host-side `PluginSourceAdapter` (`WorkSourceAdapter` over a `SourceChannel`, channel faults latch `SourceUnavailable`) + plugin-side `TrackerLogic`; `hh-tracker-fixture` — the packaged reference variant (`plugins/hh-tracker-fixture`, `subprocess_confined`, `plugin_abi/1`) genuinely spawned through `hh-varhost`; the **real** tracker leg is DF-S5.6-1 (HUMAN-H2) | `crates/hh-fleet-adapter/` · `crates/hh-tracker-fixture/` · `crates/hh-varhost/tests/tracker_plugin.rs` |
| `FleetView` on K1/K2 + approval-inbox join (AC-10) | Ledger-derived `hh.fleet.view/2` fold (work-item identity/state, activation refs + counts, blocked/handoff, escalations, budget consumed/remaining, `external_irreversible` count, open children, capacity, ownership, cues/suspended sources, `derived_from` watermark, totals by owner/source/state, `metrics` = the fifteen catalogue declarations); V10 supervision renders the verbatim view and joins durable `security.permission.pending` rows onto items by `work_item_id` (`approval_inbox` kept whole for audit); hosted activations render `n/a{observability}` | `crates/hh-fleet/src/view.rs` · `crates/hh-web/src/views.rs` · `crates/hh-web/src/ui.rs` |
| Fourteen fleet metrics + `unowned_dispatch_count` (AC-10) | `MetricLevel::{WorkItem, Fleet}` in the ontology; `FLEET_METRICS` catalogue rows at `MetricLevel::Fleet` with declared observability + `computed_from` classes; `unowned_dispatch_count` is the `veto: true` trace predicate (ADR-0207 D4) | `crates/hh-ontology/src/eval.rs` · `crates/hh-telemetry/src/catalogue.rs` |
| Optional `ext.effects.external_irreversible` ceiling (AC-11) | Bounded pool dimension ⇒ one root-pool unit reserved per `on.external_irreversible` dispatch; exhaustion → `Refused` + durable `blocked{irreversibility_ceiling}` + escalation; absent/unset ⇒ strict no-op | `crates/hh-fleet/src/engine.rs` · `crates/hh-fleet/src/errors.rs` |
| The adapter boundary ops | `fleet.webhook_ingress`, `fleet.source_capabilities`, `fleet.source_records` on `hh-embed/1` (schema rows + regenerated client + schema export; fixture/webhook lane selection; requester provenance stamped on boundary-initiated writes) | `crates/hh-embed-schema/src/ops.rs` · `crates/hh-embed/src/fleet_ops.rs` · `crates/hh-cli/src/cli.rs` (`hh fleet` noun) |
| Adapter contract hardening | `WorkSourceAdapter` verbs are `&mut` (poll consumes the ingress queue; faults latch); `list`/`get` read minimum; `activate_run` consulted by reconciliation; a source fault maps to `SourceUnavailable` and stops further polling; `fleet_report.source_unavailable` member | `crates/hh-fleet/src/source.rs` · `engine.rs` |
| Registry class | `work_source_adapter` `ClassRecord` (contract ops + invariants + closed declaration schema; `tier: C4`) | `crates/hh-registry/src/suites.rs` |

## Decisions

See **ADR-0317** — the fixture-as-proxy ruling
(D1), the webhook secret boundary shape (D2),
`&mut` adapters vs ledger authority (D3), the
root-pool ceiling reservation (D4), the
probe-never-downgrades rule (D5), the
`FleetView.metrics` catalogue verbatim member
(D6), the inbox join as pure projection (D7).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`reconcile_stalls` polled a faulted
  adapter** — a dead `adapter.suspended(&sid)`
  probe survived the fault-latch; removed, the
  faulted-source suite asserts zero post-fault
  polls.
- **The ceiling dimension in the dispatch
  slice** produced a false
  `BudgetExceedsParent`; the reservation moved
  to the root pool and the dimension leaves the
  slice spec (ADR-0317 D4).
- **Generated client drift** — new `fleet.*`
  ops changed the schema hash (`SchemaMismatch`
  at `hello`); `cargo run -p hh-codegen`
  regenerated `generated.rs` +
  `hh-embed-1.schema.json`.
- **`check-removability.sh` extended** — the
  S4.9 fleet stanza now counts `hh-fleet-adapter`
  as the second C4-tier consumer and filters
  dev-deps from the consumer set (hh-varhost's
  fixture test consumes hh-fleet dev-only);
  `hh-tracker-fixture` joins the extension-tier
  set.
- **`hh-fleet-adapter -> hh-embed` edge avoided**
  — the boundary crate consumes `hh-fleet` +
  `hh-wire` only; nothing below C4 depends on
  the fleet layer.

## Removability

`removability(0…3)` — `check-removability.sh`
serial green on every stanza. The C4 fleet tier
remains removable: `hh-embed` builds with and
without `tier-c4`; absent the tier the new ops
stay in the schema and answer
`Unsupported{by: "tier-c4"}` (extended refusal
test). `hh-fleet-adapter`/`hh-tracker-fixture`
are leaf consumers — the adapter boundary
consumes `hh-fleet`, the packaged binary
consumes the extension tier, nothing below C4
depends on either.
